{{Hatnote|This page documents a constructed card pool. Official tournament documents remain authoritative.}}
'''Decipher Cards Only (Modified)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>open_no_virtual_m</code>). Its pool is every Decipher-printed card, set ids 1&ndash;14 and premium ids 101&ndash;112, like GEMP's [[Decipher Cards Only]] (<code>open_no_virtual</code>). Unlike [[Classic (no v-cards)]], it has no icon bans.<ref name="gemp" />

== Ban list ==
GEMP bans five cards:<ref name="gemp" />
* Dark Side: ''An Entire Legion Of My Best Troops'', ''Boonta Eve Podrace'', ''Coruscant: Galactic Senate''
* Light Side: ''Boonta Eve Podrace'', ''Coruscant: Galactic Senate''
